blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s lawyers face the challenge of disproving allegations that she amassed unexplained wealth while in office as her Senate impeachment trial resumes today following a nearly monthlong recess, amid mounting pressure for her to take the witness stand.
